General information.Name: market for natural gas liquids
General information.Description: This is a market activity representing the consumption mix of natural gas liquids in the Global geography. The market connects suppliers with consumers of the same product in the same geographical area, grouping producers and imports. This market contains no transport or losses as they are irrelevant for the delivered product. Natural gas liquids is a fossil fuel with a calorific value of 24.624 MJ/kg used as a liquid fuel sourced from unprocessed natural gas. Main applications include domestic fuel for cooking and heating, industrial fuel and plastics raw material. The activity starts at the gate of the activities that produce natural gas liquids within Global geography and ends with the supply to consumers.
General information.Tags: market activity, natural gas liquids, fossil fuel, energy market, global supply chain
General information.Technology | Description: Market activity technology that represents the consumption mix and supply chain for natural gas liquids. This includes grouping producers and imports within the Global geography, connecting suppliers with consumers without considering transport or losses as they are irrelevant for this delivered product.
